name: miaai-lab/inkling-2-mini-dgx-spark-tensorfold
title: MiaAI Lab updates its TensorFold recipes for Inkling 2 Mini: DGX Spark decode up 21 to 35%, RTX 5090 and PRO 6000 up 43 to 66%
summary: New versions of MiaAI Lab's open run recipes raise single-stream Inkling 2 Mini decode on one DGX Spark from 48 to 64 tok/s and prefill from about 3.5k to 4.3k tok/s; the RTX 5090 and RTX PRO 6000 recipes reach 230 tok/s single stream and 679 tok/s at 8 streams. Directly useful for serving Inkling 2 Mini on a Spark.
